body:
Both components slot into `MDXViewer.components` by lowercased tag name:

```
<Stats> / <Stat> / <ADR>
  ──▶ rehype-raw turns the inline HTML into hast elements
  ──▶ react-markdown dispatches tag → components map
  ──▶ { stats: Stats, stat: Stat, adr: ADR } in MDXViewer.tsx
  ──▶ component renders its own Tailwind JSX
```

No remark plugins, no new fence languages, no info-string grammar.

---
